task_instance: Scaffold a minimal ChatGPT Apps SDK app: a Node/Express MCP server exposing a data tool (list_tasks, read-only/idempotent), a mutating tool (toggle_task), and a widget UI resource (text/html;profile=mcp-app) rendered via the MCP Apps bridge (structuredContent + ui/notifications/tool-result + window.openai.callTool fallback). Validate the local /mcp loop end-to-end.
evidence: Built server.js (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk McpServer + StreamableHTTPServerTransport) and widget.html in /tmp/.../exec/openai__skills__chatgpt-apps/. `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk express zod` succeeded (network available). Started server with `node server.js` (listened on http://localhost:8787/mcp). Verified the full MCP handshake with raw JSON-RPC POSTs via curl: (1) initialize -> returned protocolVersion/serverInfo; (2) tools/list -> returned list_tasks and toggle_task with correct annotations (readOnlyHint/idempotentHint on list_tasks, destructiveHint:false/idempotentHint:false on toggle_task) and _meta.openai/outputTemplate + _meta.ui.resourceUri pointing at the widget; (3) resources/list -> returned the ui://widget/kanban-1.html resource with mimeType text/html;profile=mcp-app; (4) tools/call list_tasks -> returned structuredContent with 3 tasks; (5) tools/call toggle_task id=2 -> mutated state, returned task 2 as done:true (confirmed idempotent-vs-mutating behavior actually works); (6) resources/read -> returned the widget HTML text verbatim. This satisfies the skill's 'minimum working repo contract' (server + tools wired to a reachable /mcp endpoint, widget resource registered with the MCP Apps UI mime type, tool annotations set) and the low-cost validation ladder (static review + local /mcp health/functional check) described in the skill. Not attempted (out of scope for this runtime, not core-deliverable blockers): the `$openai-docs` docs-first lookup (no openai-docs skill/MCP tool present in this session, so doc citations were skipped and the scaffold was written from the SKILL.md's own inline guidance instead), ngrok/public HTTPS tunneling and connecting to real ChatGPT Developer Mode (needs an OpenAI/ChatGPT account and public network exposure), and public app-directory submission (needs org verification/account). The repo's `scripts/scaffold_node_ext_apps.mjs` referenced by the skill was not present in the skill folder (only SKILL.md and LICENSE were bundled), so the server/widget were hand-written following the skill's architecture guidance rather than running that script.
